selection: Start with production-volume unless current durable ticket authority already contains a complex trigger. Escalation changes the next clean implementation boundary, not an active candidate mid-flight.
complex_triggers: novel or cross-cutting architecture spanning materially coupled modules
complex concurrency, temporal, scheduling, state-machine, solver or optimization semantics
material security, privacy, authorization, tenancy, clinical-meaning or trust-boundary risk
delicate data migration, backwards compatibility or distributed invariant work
repeated semantic or bounded-correction failure under production-volume
non_triggers: a long but mechanically clear ticket
business importance without corresponding reasoning or semantic risk
review_transport: Qualified OpenCode V1 native Gentle transport. Review roles remain separate and use the profile-specific multimodel mappings already established for production-volume and complex.
profile_boundary: Do not switch implementation/review profile in the middle of an active candidate/review lineage. Preserve evidence and change route at the next clean candidate/work-unit boundary.
